ازدريتما (form VIII)
# اِزْدَرَيْتُمَا (izdaraytumā) /iz.da.raj.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# اُزْدُرِيتُمَا (uzdurītumā) /uz.du.riː.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
